chengdu-marathon|2026-10-25.summary: A road marathon from Jinsha Site Museum to Century City International Convention and Exhibition Centre.

Marathon.label: First wave 07:30 · later wave 07:50
Marathon.note: 2026 regulations: elite runners and marathon groups A/B/C start at 07:30; marathon groups D/E at 07:50. China Standard Time (UTC+8). The 08:10 start is for half marathon groups F/G and must not be assigned to the marathon.

oktoberfest-half-college-station|2026-10.summary: The BCS Oktoberfest half marathon finishes inside Kyle Field.

Half.label: Starts from 07:00 CDT · check your wave
Half.note: The organiser's 2026 authorised entry programme explicitly lists the half marathon and 10K start at 07:00 CDT. Individual wave allocation was not verified: the linked organiser website was unavailable and a newer social timetable could not be opened. Preserve 07:00 as the first published start, not a universal participant start. Entry page says sold out and online registration closed.
Half.publicNote: Published starts begin at 07:00 CDT (UTC−5). Follow your assigned wave in the organiser's race instructions. Registration is closed; no race-day packet pickup.

wa-athletics-sa-state-all-schools-champi.summary: Day two of Athletics South Australia's VIVA SA All Schools track and field championships.

Track & field.label: Programme starts 09:00 ACDT
Track & field.note: The 2026 VIVA SA All Schools Athletics South Australia programme gives Sunday 09:00 for the first walks and long jumps. This is the meeting programme start, not every athlete's event start. Full programme at https://liveresults.com.au/261024/; the World Athletics fixture confirms the 24–25 October edition.
Track & field.publicNote: Sunday's programme begins at 09:00 ACDT (UTC+10:30). Individual track and field events have separate start times; check the event programme.

niagara-falls-international-marathon|202.summary: The 2026 marathon runs entirely in Canada, starting on Fallsview Boulevard and finishing on Stanley Avenue.

Marathon.label: Provisional 08:15 EDT
Marathon.note: The organiser's 2026 marathon page and Sunday timetable both give 08:15, but the page explicitly labels the start tentative. Retain that qualification and do not publish an exact calendar instant. The 2026 course is entirely in Canada; the previous border-marathon note is superseded.
Marathon.publicNote: The organiser lists 08:15 EDT (UTC−4) as tentative. Confirm the final instructions before travelling. Start: Fallsview Boulevard between Murray and Robinson Streets; no race-day bib pickup.
